title: Tony Newstead, Frank Johnson and Len Bernard bands
summary: Polites describes the loose Chicago style of Newstead and the Johnson and Bernard bands, whose records he thinks the best made in Australia.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
